summary: Google DeepMind and Isomorphic Labs describe their joint bioresilience program, covering safety processes to prevent misuse of AI models and partnerships to help detect and respond to disease outbreaks.

practices.reason: The four-step safety process described (threat modeling, evaluations, mitigations, monitoring) is a lab-internal methodology, informative but not directly transferable as a benchmark or instrument.
practices.quote: we follow a four-step safety process: threat modeling, evaluations, mitigations and monitoring.
